outputs.explanation: Panel A is a bar chart of Tmprss11b normalized counts across mouse models (mean ± SD), and individual biological replicate values are overlaid as colored dots for each group.
Panel B is a schematic diagram of the experimental workflow (Ad-Cre administration, MRI imaging, tissue harvest), not a data plot, so individual data points are not applicable.
Panel C shows representative MRI images of mice at 3 and 4 months post-infection; this is imaging data, not a plot of averaged values, so individual data points are not applicable.
Panel D shows representative H&E micrographs of mouse lung tissue, not a quantitative plot, so individual data points are not applicable.
Panel E shows H&E and RNAscope fluorescence micrographs of a lung section, not a plot of averaged values, so individual data points are not applicable.
Panel F shows zoomed-in H&E and RNAscope micrographs comparing squamous tumor and normal lung regions, not a quantitative plot, so individual data points are not applicable.
Panel G shows H&E and RNAscope micrographs with annotated tumor regions, not a plot of averaged values, so individual data points are not applicable.
